findings.source_quote: If you want to receive one or more copies of this booklet, we ask that you contact us with your contact information and the number of booklets desired, even if you have previously done so. This will help us gauge the interest level to know how many we should print. We can be reached by mail, phone, or email, each of which can be found inside the front cover of each issue of our magazine, The Heartbeat of the Remnant.
